hours.source: Google Maps hours field (Mon-Fri 9 AM-3 PM office hours, Sat/Sun closed). Catering events themselves clearly happen on weekends too (wedding reviews, grand-opening review for a 'past weekend'), so the site frames office hours separately from event days.

language_evidence: All 5 reviews collected from Google Maps are written in English (Vanessa Lebron, Alfa, G J P, Jordan Yates, Cameron Albert). No Instagram/Facebook page was found to check caption language. Despite the Dominican name and menu, the verifiable public-facing text (reviews) is English, so the site defaults to English with a full Spanish toggle (bilingual required either way).
owners: Chef Ivan and Kenia, confirmed by name in two separate Google reviews (Alfa: 'Thank you so much Ivan and Kenia!'; Jordan Yates: 'Ivan and his staff (Kenya, Jonas, and others)'; G J P: 'Chef Ivan is wonderful').
services_real: Event and wedding catering (reviews mention weddings and a 90+ person grand opening)
Home delivery of platters, including same-day delivery (G J P review: platters delivered to a grieving family's home)
Dominican and Caribbean menu: mangu, churrasco, pulled pork, roasted chicken (seen in photos and mentioned in reviews)
Appetizers and dessert tables for events (shrimp ceviche skewers, charcuterie boards, dessert spreads, seen in photos)
pricing_note: No prices published anywhere (Google Maps, no booking platform, no website). Catering is quoted per event by guest count and menu, so the site uses 'Call for pricing' per the adapted-variant rule, never an invented price.

reviews_verbatim.author: Vanessa Lebron
reviews_verbatim.text: Mangu Mangu Catering is hands down the best! They work with you from beginning to end, offering different menus based on your taste and making sure everything is set up beautifully on the day of your event.
reviews_verbatim.source: Google Maps review (full text was truncated by Google with '...'; trimmed here at the last complete sentence before the cut, no words added)

reviews_verbatim.author: G J P
reviews_verbatim.text: Chef Ivan is wonderful. Today, I needed food to be delivered to a home in Cutler Bay. Sadly, someone was grieving due to the sudden loss of a loved one and I requested platters be delivered asap. I wasn't sure if it would be possible.
reviews_verbatim.source: Google Maps review (truncated by Google, trimmed at last complete sentence)

reviews_verbatim.author: Jordan Yates
reviews_verbatim.text: I used Mangu-Mangu for our grand opening for 90+ people this past weekend. Ivan and his staff (Kenya, Jonas, and others) were incredible.
reviews_verbatim.source: Google Maps review (truncated by Google, trimmed at last complete sentence)

reviews_verbatim.author: Alfa
reviews_verbatim.text: I had the pleasure to enjoy this meal in our wedding day! Thank you so much Ivan and Kenia! The food was delicious and yummy! People were surprised with The mangu. Wow and the dessert was spectacular! We enjoyed your food, everything was fresh and delicious!
reviews_verbatim.source: Google Maps review (emoji removed for display, wording otherwise verbatim, trimmed at last complete sentence before Google's truncation)

reviews_verbatim.author: Cameron Albert
reviews_verbatim.text: NICE...food was amazing and prices are good too the only complaint is that there located in the back of the building and have no signs or advertisement. They get some visuals and directions and this spot can be big.
reviews_verbatim.source: Google Maps review (complete, not truncated, kept exactly verbatim including grammar)
